categories.main_business_segments: Beijing FJR Optoelectronic Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of infrared thermal imaging products and systems. Its main product categories include core modules (machine cores), thermal imagers, and optoelectronic systems. The company serves both military and civilian markets, providing customized solutions tailored to diverse customer needs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies in infrared thermal imaging, including detector drive control, image processing algorithms, embedded hardware architecture, servo control, and special optical system design. It independently develops non-cooled infrared detectors using MEMS technology, high-vacuum ceramic packaging, and integrated optoelectronic systems such as panoramic infrared radar. Production methods emphasize customized design, integration of optics, electronics, and mechanics, and a combination of in-house manufacturing with outsourced processing for non-core components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include military general units and civilian system integrators. Military applications cover infantry, ground, air, and naval equipment, while civilian applications span industrial temperature measurement, gas detection, petrochemical, power inspection, security monitoring, medical quarantine, and firefighting. The company maintains stable relationships with major state-owned military groups and actively expands its civilian and overseas markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant sales in North China, East China, Northeast, Central, Southwest, South China, and Northwest regions. It also actively develops overseas markets for civilian products. Its registered and operational headquarters are located in Beijing, with subsidiaries in various Chinese cities including Xi'an and Luoyang.
categories.supply_chain_position: FJR operates mainly in the midstream segment of the infrared optoelectronic industry, focusing on the design and manufacture of core components like machine cores and thermal imagers, as well as integrated optoelectronic systems. It is expanding upstream capabilities by developing non-cooled infrared detectors to reduce reliance on external suppliers and improve cost control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes deepening infrared imaging technology research, expanding into solid-state low-light, short-wave, ultraviolet, and visible light domains, and advancing multi-spectral integrated optoelectronic systems and panoramic radar. It emphasizes non-cooled infrared detector development and industrialization to enhance core technology control and profitability. R&D investments are substantial, focusing on product innovation, algorithm development, and system integration, supported by collaborations with research institutes and universities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized infrared imaging products and systems to military and civilian customers. The company employs a direct sales model, providing tailored solutions and technical support. Revenue streams include product sales of machine cores, thermal imagers, optoelectronic systems, and related components, with some income from government subsidies and occasional asset disposals.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: FJR positions itself as a specialized midstream supplier in the infrared thermal imaging industry, focusing on core technology and integration capabilities. It competes with domestic and international firms, particularly in the military segment dominated by state-owned enterprises. The company leverages its technological innovation, patent portfolio, and customized solutions to maintain competitiveness despite intense market competition and pricing pressures.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 209.3 million, an 88.77% increase year-over-year, driven by military procurement and civilian market expansion. However, it recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 96.3 million, reflecting increased R&D expenses and competitive pricing pressures. Total assets were about RMB 669.7 million, with a decline in net assets. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D, accounting for 34.69% of revenue, indicating a growth-oriented but currently loss-making profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: FJR emphasizes its strong core technology base, including proprietary non-cooled infrared detectors, advanced image processing algorithms, and integrated optoelectronic systems. Its value proposition lies in providing highly customized, high-performance infrared imaging solutions tailored to diverse military and civilian applications. The company highlights its comprehensive design and integration capabilities, rapid R&D cycles, and a robust patent portfolio as key differentiators that enable it to meet stringent customer requirements and adapt to evolving market demands.
